review.notes: Full read-through of the OCR lines against extracted text from all 25 physical PDF pages, plus code-fence and heading-structure checks (no fence markers in this source; structure clean). Physical pages 6, 11 and 25 were rendered at 300 dpi to visually confirm the dropped footnote bodies restored by patches 1-3; page 18 confirmed the Vaswani URL underscore. The document's own misspellings printed by the PDF ("fine-turning" p.3, "mehtods" p.13) were verified in the source text layer and intentionally preserved. The arXiv sidebar stamp on physical p.1 and table-header cell order in Table 3 are not transcription defects.
